title: Candidate conditional kappa 0.001017923290728024: propagated entrance frames
body:
Conditional κ = **0.001017923290728024** (`127240411341003/125000000000000000`), **0.01230651% above #416**. Subsequent #419 reports `0.001017962405296845`, which is higher than this PR. #420 reports a value below this PR.

Apply #416's four frame-propagating gauge promotions to our #415 word, with exact relation transport. Three relations transfer directly. The relation for 892 initially fails on target coordinates 133 and 149 because 1010 is already gauged; substituting its explicit #409 relation repairs every rational response equation. Both the rejected transfer and corrected witness are retained.

The combined word has 208 gauges, 560 entrance instructions and five propagated original-A frame changes. Its local paid delta is `{1:+8,2:-3,3:+1,4:-2,7:+1,8:-1}`, reducing rank mass by four. Outside the 25 new entrance shears, original A scalar groups are preserved.

Validation on the published mathematical code (`e4a8214d0c13ad5d7a436a848448f614a6ca9c79`):

- All 1,021 full-word and pre-snapshot raw columns, literal shear multiplication, gauged zero-response columns, nested paths, final endpoints, five reverted-frame controls and an omitted-gate control passed.
- Both formal scalar orientations, private erasure, chronological target matrix, 7,057 recomputed dirty-response entries and 7,158 unit macros passed. All 854 new/reflected Gaussian phase pairs and 16 signed coefficient microchecks passed.
- Changed physical assembly, independent owner/padding decoder and eight structural controls, regenerated finite invoice, reserve bridge, two rational moment engines and 47 strict outer inequalities passed.
- Fresh bit composition passed at this exact complex bound. All eight package manifests passed.

[Successful receipts and retained failures](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff8737920a4bb1a910eb069a5f86db6efdefa589/research/e8-propagated-entrances/VALIDATION-LOCAL.json) are committed with raw and compressed hashes. The first physical replay failed while serializing its template with `OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device`. After lossless archival of completed local outputs, the unchanged code passed in a fresh output directory. No mathematical assertion was bypassed.

**Still pending:** uninterrupted replay of the complete parent/new wrapper and Python 3.11/3.14 CI. Separate component passes are not represented as a full wrapper pass. Draft-first publication was followed by the local checks above; the PR remains a draft.

32 replicas; 2,941 banks per stage; 57,189 live and 57,980 physical registers. The invoice charges 32,774,592 real primitives, local bound 9,400,678,229,684, 119,808 bank-boundary adapters and row reserve 15,449 < 20,161. Complex lower: `254740128591982906821/250000000000000000000000`; unchanged bit lower: `255384852701747/250000000000000000`.

Run `python -B research/e8-propagated-entrances/verify.py /absolute/path/to/new/output`. This freshly runs all of #415, this construction and fresh bit, checking all eight manifests before and after.

This uses the same broader chronological/dyadic framework as #415/#416. No unchanged legacy gx/gxcore E4/E5 acceptance, Lean theorem or unconditional multiplication exponent is claimed. All-size window, arbitrary dirty-bank, compiler, fixed-tape, restored-row, common-grid, precision and analytic interfaces remain conditional.
